gloss_en: wonder/marvel (pele) — the hidden, transcendent 'wondrous' quality (as in Isaiah 29:14 'hafle va-fele' and Isaiah 25:1 'asita pele'), associated in LM I:57 both with the departure/concealment of the Sages' wisdom and with the vow ('ki yafli lindor neder', Num 6:2) that rectifies it; not the verb 'to separate/set apart' in other senses
